description: This file is part of the 'pipecat' project, under the 'services' module, and manages deprecated module access by warning users when deprecated modules are accessed. It defines helper functions and a proxy class for handling deprecation warnings and attribute access.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class that wraps access to deprecated modules, issues deprecation warnings on attribute access, and forwards attribute access to the actual globals.

methods.name: _warn_deprecated_access(globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Issues a deprecation warning if the module pair has not been warned before, then accesses the specified attribute from the globals dictionary.

methods.name: __init__(self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy, initializes with globals, old module name, and new module name.

methods.name: __getattr__(self, attr)
methods.description: Intercepts attribute access, issues warning if attribute exists in globals, otherwise raises AttributeError.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str):$/
ctags.signature: (self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str)

ctags.name: _warn_deprecated_access
ctags.pattern: /^def _warn_deprecated_access(globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str):$/
ctags.signature: (globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str)
